releasePolicy: Every generated scenario is release-blocking and must have end-to-end evidence before the milestone can ship.

requirements.given: a valid account on the home server
requirements.then: the client reaches the workspace with the correct identity

requirements.given: an authenticated member who restarts the client
requirements.then: the session is restored or reauthentication is requested without losing local state

requirements.given: invalid or expired credentials
requirements.then: access is denied with a recoverable, non-secret-bearing error

journeys.title: Accept an invite and join the community

requirements.given: a valid invitation
requirements.then: the member joins the intended community and starter conversations

requirements.given: a community with rules, default roles, starter rooms, and a selected developer-community template
requirements.then: rules acceptance is durably recorded and only the configured roles, rooms, forums, and welcome checklist are applied

requirements.given: an expired, revoked, or unauthorized invitation
requirements.then: joining is refused without creating partial membership

requirements.given: a pilot onboarding cohort
requirements.when: invite acceptance and first engagement are measured
requirements.then: median invite-to-first-message is below three minutes and at least 60 percent of accepted invitees read, react, or post within 24 hours

journeys.title: Discover, join, and converse in a room

requirements.given: an authorized member and visible room
requirements.then: membership, occupants, and recent context become visible

requirements.given: two joined members
requirements.then: both clients show one stable, correctly attributed message

requirements.given: a joined member
requirements.then: the room stops producing member-only traffic for that member

requirements.given: two members permitted to contact each other
requirements.then: both members see one stable, correctly attributed message

requirements.given: a blocked sender
requirements.then: the recipient receives no message or presence leak

requirements.given: a conversation with archived messages
requirements.when: the member pages backward and jumps to context
requirements.then: messages remain ordered, deduplicated, and permission-filtered

requirements.given: a member whose access was revoked
requirements.then: protected history is not disclosed

journeys.title: Track unread, mentions, and displayed state

requirements.given: new messages in an unfocused conversation
requirements.when: the member opens and reads through them
requirements.then: unread and mention counts increment once and clear on every device

requirements.given: read state recorded before restart
requirements.then: counts converge without resurrecting cleared items

requirements.given: an eligible message while the client is backgrounded
requirements.then: one privacy-preserving alert reaches the member and opens the correct context

requirements.given: a muted conversation or disabled notification class
requirements.then: no alert is emitted while unread state remains correct

journeys.title: Search the workspace and jump to context

requirements.given: authorized searchable messages, people, rooms, forums, threads, and files
requirements.when: the member searches with entity, sender, room, and date filters and selects a result
requirements.then: matching results identify their type and context and open at the selected entity

requirements.given: history outside the member's permissions
requirements.then: no result, snippet, count, or identifier leaks that history

journeys.title: Upload, send, and open a file

requirements.given: an authorized member and supported file
requirements.when: the member uploads and sends it
requirements.then: recipients can inspect metadata and open the uncorrupted file

requirements.given: a rejected or interrupted upload
requirements.then: no successful message is shown and retry is safe

journeys.title: Reply in and catch up with a thread

requirements.given: a message that can be replied to
requirements.when: a member replies in its thread
requirements.then: the reply retains stable parent and thread context on every client

requirements.given: unread thread activity
requirements.when: the member opens the thread inbox
requirements.then: the activity is discoverable and can be marked read without changing unrelated conversations

requirements.given: a visible message
requirements.then: all clients converge on the same per-sender reaction set without duplicate counts

requirements.given: reportable content
requirements.then: authorized moderators receive attributable evidence without notifying the reported member

requirements.given: open reports with evidence and reasons
requirements.when: a moderator reviews, assigns, resolves, or escalates them
requirements.then: queue state is durable, permission-scoped, auditable, and visible to the moderation team within five seconds

requirements.given: an authorized moderator
requirements.when: the moderator retracts content or applies timeout, kick, or ban
requirements.then: the action propagates within two seconds, is auditable, and is denied to unauthorized actors

requirements.given: configured keyword or rate rules and an appeal policy
requirements.when: automod acts or a sanctioned member appeals
requirements.then: the rule, evidence, decision, reviewer, and resulting action remain attributable and fail closed

journeys.title: Start, join, recover, and leave a call

requirements.given: permitted members and available media devices
requirements.when: a member starts or joins a direct or room call
requirements.then: participants can exchange media, observe participant state, and leave cleanly

requirements.given: an active call with permitted participants
requirements.when: a member selects input/output devices, shares or stops sharing a screen, mutes, raises a hand, or a moderator manages a participant
requirements.then: every participant observes the authorized state transition exactly once and denied controls remain unavailable

requirements.given: an active call with a transient connection loss
requirements.then: the call recovers or ends with an explicit actionable state

journeys.title: Reconnect without message loss or duplication

requirements.given: a connected client with in-flight and missed traffic
requirements.then: stream resumption or archive catch-up produces a complete deduplicated timeline

requirements.given: an expired resumable session
requirements.then: the client establishes a fresh stream and catches up without silent gaps

requirements.given: the same member online on two clients
requirements.when: either client sends, receives, or displays a message
requirements.then: both clients converge on message and read state without duplicate notifications

requirements.given: a revoked client session
requirements.then: access is denied without disrupting other active clients

requirements.given: a member using screen-reader, high-contrast, zoom, reduced-motion, or switch-control settings
requirements.when: the member completes authentication, navigation, messaging, search, files, calls, and moderation flows
requirements.then: the flow meets WCAG 2.2 AA with named controls, logical focus order, announced state changes, and no pointer-only action

journeys.title: Operate core collaboration journeys by keyboard

requirements.given: a keyboard-only member
requirements.when: the member navigates workspaces, conversations, messages, threads, search, composer actions, settings, calls, and moderation
requirements.then: every action is reachable with visible focus, documented shortcuts do not conflict, and focus returns to the initiating control after dismissal

requirements.given: the versioned dataset, hardware, and network in the contract performance profile
requirements.when: a member launches, opens a conversation, searches, sends, or joins a call
requirements.then: web p75 LCP is at most 2.5 seconds, web p75 INP is at most 200 milliseconds, native launch-to-interactive is at most 2.5 seconds, and conversation/search actions acknowledge input within 100 milliseconds

journeys.title: Install, update, and recover the Android PWA

requirements.given: a supported Android browser and authenticated member
requirements.when: the member installs and launches Waddle
requirements.then: the standalone app restores the authenticated workspace and deep links to the intended conversation

requirements.given: a previously launched installation
requirements.then: the app shell and cached context remain usable and clearly distinguish unavailable network actions

requirements.given: an installed older application version with queued local state
requirements.then: the update preserves queued state and either migrates or explicitly rejects incompatible state without silent loss

requirements.given: an authorized community administrator
requirements.when: the administrator invites, approves, assigns roles, suspends, bans, revokes sessions, removes, exports, or deletes a member
requirements.then: the requested lifecycle transition is atomic, permission-scoped, visible on active clients within 60 seconds, and durably audited

requirements.given: a configured role and channel policy
requirements.when: an administrator previews the community as that role
requirements.then: the preview matches server authorization without granting the administrator a new session or mutating membership

requirements.given: destructive and administrative actions
requirements.then: 100 percent contain actor, target, reason, timestamp, result, and correlation identifier

requirements.given: an authorized administrator
requirements.then: delivery, push, federation, extensions, backups, and recent incidents show freshness, degraded state, and an actionable diagnostic without exposing member content

requirements.given: a non-administrator
requirements.then: the request is denied without leaking infrastructure, identity, or incident details

requirements.given: a current supported Prosody peer
requirements.when: users exchange presence, direct messages, history, and reconnect across domains
requirements.then: delivery is bidirectional, ordered, deduplicated, and capability-aware

requirements.given: a current supported ejabberd peer
requirements.when: users exchange presence, direct messages, history, and reconnect across domains
requirements.then: delivery is bidirectional, ordered, deduplicated, and capability-aware

requirements.given: a current supported Snikket peer
requirements.when: users exchange presence, direct messages, history, and reconnect across domains
requirements.then: delivery is bidirectional, ordered, deduplicated, and capability-aware

requirements.given: authorized local and remote members
requirements.when: a remote member accepts an invitation, joins a Waddle room, exchanges messages and files, reconnects, and is moderated
requirements.then: room state, archive visibility, invitation semantics, moderation, and recovery remain conformant across domains

requirements.given: valid, invalid, expired, and mismatched peer certificates plus dialback fallback
requirements.then: TLS, SASL EXTERNAL, SRV/direct-TLS discovery, and encrypted dialback enforce the configured trust policy without downgrade

journeys.title: Recover safely from a remote-domain failure

requirements.given: a remote domain that is unavailable or rejects delivery
requirements.then: local traffic remains healthy and remote delivery is queued, retried, or visibly failed without duplication

requirements.given: a blocked, malformed, or quota-exhausting remote domain
requirements.then: the traffic is rejected and cannot exhaust shared resources or bypass moderation policy
